title: Dropbox app auth token placeholders, references, masks and the client credentials request with placeholders
summary: The documented <OAUTH2_APP_AUTH_TOKEN> placeholder, an environment reference, a template reference, a masked display and a bare scheme in the Bearer slot, a client credentials token request whose app key and app secret are placeholders, and a Basic header over a placeholder.
rationale: Dropbox shows the Bearer slot with the placeholder <OAUTH2_APP_AUTH_TOKEN> (claim app-auth-token-bearer-carrier) and the client credentials request with the app key and app secret as inputs (claim app-auth-token-request-inputs); App Authentication also accepts the app key and secret as Basic credentials (claim app-authentication-accepts-secret-or-token). A placeholder, a reference, a masked display and a bare scheme stand in for a value kept elsewhere. The app key is deliberately absent as a literal: Dropbox does not label it non-secret (claim app-key-is-sent-in-authorize-url), so the case asserts nothing about it, and the app secret and the token derived from it both appear here only as placeholders. Contract claims cited: app-auth-token/app-auth-token-bearer-carrier, app-auth-token/app-auth-token-request-inputs.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#243). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Not flagged under project policy: these inputs hold no token or secret value. That a documented placeholder, reference, masked display or bare scheme is not a value is the project's decision; Dropbox documents the placeholder and the request inputs (carrier facts only).

sources.supports: When using an app auth token, it is supplied as a bearer token in an authorization header.
Calls to /oauth2/token need to be authenticated using the apps's key and secret. ... Example: app auth token request in client credentials flow
